options.name: a10_device_context_id
options.description: Device ID for aVCS configuration

options.name: a10_partition
options.description: Destination/target partition for object/command

options.name: account
options.description: Specify AD domain account

options.name: accounting_server
options.description: Specify a RADIUS accounting server

options.name: accounting_service_group
options.description: Specify an authentication service group for RADIUS accounting

options.name: ansible_host
options.description: Host for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_password
options.description: Password for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_port
options.description: Port for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_username
options.description: Username for AXAPI authentication

options.name: auth_sess_mode
options.description: 'cookie-based'= Track auth-session by cookie (default); 'ip-based'= Track auth- session by client IP;

options.name: cookie_domain
options.description: Field cookie_domain

options.name: cookie_domain_group
options.description: Field cookie_domain_group

options.name: cookie_httponly_enable
options.description: Enable httponly attribute for AAM cookies

options.name: cookie_max_age
options.description: Configure Max-Age for authentication session cookie (Configure Max-Age in seconds. System will not set Max-Age/Expires for value 0 and default is 604800 (1 week).)

options.name: cookie_samesite
options.description: 'strict'= Specify SameSite attribute as Strict for AAM cookie; 'lax'= Specify SameSite attribute as Lax for AAM cookie; 'none'= Specify SameSite attribute as None for AAM cookie;

options.name: cookie_secure_enable
options.description: Enable secure attribute for AAM cookies

options.name: forward_logout_disable
options.description: Disable forward logout request to backend application server. The config-field logout-url must be configured first

options.name: jwt
options.description: Specify authentication jwt template

options.name: local_logging
options.description: Enable local logging

options.name: log
options.description: 'use-partition-level-config'= Use configuration of authentication-log enable command; 'enable'= Enable authentication logs for this template; 'disable'= Disable authentication logs for this template;

options.name: logon
options.description: Specify authentication logon (Specify authentication logon template name)

options.name: logout_idle_timeout
options.description: Specify idle logout time (Specify idle timeout in seconds, default is 300)

options.name: logout_url
options.description: Specify logout url (Specify logout url string)

options.name: max_session_time
options.description: Specify default SAML token lifetime (Specify lifetime (in seconds) of SAML token when it not provided by token attributes, default is 28800. (0 for indefinite))

options.name: modify_content_security_policy
options.description: Put redirect-uri or service-principal-name into CSP header to avoid CPS break authentication process

options.name: name
options.description: Authentication template name

options.name: ntype
options.description: 'saml'= SAML authentication template; 'standard'= Standard authentication template;

options.name: redirect_hostname
options.description: Hostname(Length 1-31) for transparent-proxy authentication

options.name: relay
options.description: Specify authentication relay (Specify authentication relay template name)

options.name: saml_idp
options.description: Specify SAML identity provider

options.name: saml_sp
options.description: Specify SAML service provider

options.name: server
options.description: Specify authentication server (Specify authentication server template name)

options.name: service_group
options.description: Bind an authentication service group to this template (Specify authentication service group name)

options.name: state
options.description: State of the object to be created.

options.name: user_tag
options.description: Customized tag

options.name: uuid
options.description: uuid of the object
